definitions.explanation: An organization recognized by law as having its own legal rights and obligations, such as a company, foundation, or association. Contrasted with {個人|こじん} (individual/natural person).

examples.japanese: {法人|ほうじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}した→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧。
{法人税|ほうじんぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A reduction in corporate tax is being considered.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{法人|ほうじん}{向|む}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This account is for corporations; individuals cannot apply.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and business term. Frequently used as a modifier: {法人|ほうじん}{税|ぜい} (corporate tax), {法人|ほうじん}{向|む}け (for corporations), {法人|ほうじん}{名|めい} (corporate name). Often contrasted with ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧ (individual).

Types of {法人|ほうじん} include ⟦{株式会社|かぶしきがいしゃ}→株式会社：19101_kabushikigaisha⟧ (stock corporation), NPO{法人|ほうじん} (NPO), and {社団法人|しゃだんほうじん} (incorporated association).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法人税|ほうじんぜい}: corporate tax
- {法人|ほうじん}{向|む}け: for corporate clients
- {法人|ほうじん}{名|めい}: corporate name
- {法人|ほうじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to establish a corporation
- NPO{法人|ほうじん}: NPO (nonprofit organization)
